integrity: Integral homotopy type follows from a fully checked acyclic discrete Morse matching and signed attaching-degree coefficients; independently checked simplicial ranks over three fields are corroborative, not an integral substitute.
limitations: The theorem is exact for the explicitly specified Kummer biplane and two graph presentations, not all (16,6,2) biplanes. Full literature exhaustiveness cannot be guaranteed.
title: The Kummer biplane block complex has an integral projective-plane summand
